title: SIMD bipedal3 kernel via generic BatchedBipedalLike framework
description:
Implement the AVX2 SIMD bipedal3 kernel inside `gf2-kernels-simd`, instantiated via the generic `BatchedBipedalLike

` framework chosen by the R4 microbench outcome. ## Background R4 (`c7542983`) selected the generic `BatchedBipedalLike` framework over per-prime hand-rolled kernels — see the R4 decision doc once that issue closes. This issue lands the AVX2 instantiation for $\mathbb{F}_3$ ($P=3$) at `gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/`, exposing the lane-batch `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` primitives that T13 wires to. D4 (`4c534d31`) confirmed the AVX2 intrinsics needed (`_mm256_and_si256`, `_mm256_xor_si256`, `_mm256_or_si256`, load/store) are stable on MSRV 1.95. The dev host has AVX2 only; AVX-512 paths in this issue are `[aspirational]` and gated behind `cfg(target_feature = "avx512f")` with a scalar fallback. `unsafe` is allowed in this crate per the project's unsafe-isolation rule. The kernel must produce an asm artefact under `target/release/deps/` that the `asm-artefact-present` gate can detect. ## Success Criteria - [ ] [hard] `gf2-kernels-simd/src/bipedal/bipedal3.rs` exists with the generic framework instantiated for $\mathbb{F}_3$ on AVX2. - [ ] [hard] Lane-batch `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` primitives match `Bipedal3` ops bitwise on 1000 random inputs (proptest cross-check). - [ ] [hard] AVX2 path uses runtime feature detection via `OnceLock` per the project's existing `simd::maybe_simd()` pattern; scalar fallback when AVX2 is absent. - [ ] [aspirational] AVX-512 path exists behind `cfg(target_feature = "avx512f")`; on the dev host (5900X, no AVX-512) the path is compiled but never exercised. - [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-kernels-simd --release --profile ci` passes. - [ ] [hard] `asm-artefact-present` gate passes (kernel produces inspectable AVX2 ops in `objdump -d`).
